verdict.rationale: Porting a number out of a cloud phone service is a fair question for Aircall. Nothing in the evidence pack covers port-out, lock-in or exit fees, or exposing the account details a gaining carrier needs. The pack only covers API tutorials, calling features, AI assistants and pricing-page dialer features.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
